recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的骨髓腔被片狀、細胞質豐富且淡粉紅灰色、呈細纖維至泡沫狀的大型組織球取代，核小而偏位、分布稀疏，殘存造血細胞被擠到邊緣，符合儲積症巨噬細胞（storage cell）浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large histiocytes filling the intertrabecular marrow space
Abundant pale eosinophilic-grey cytoplasm with a fibrillary to finely foamy texture and indistinct cell borders
Small round to oval bland nuclei, often eccentric, with low N:C ratio
Scattered small lymphocytes and residual hematopoietic cells, some with retraction halos, at the periphery
Bony trabeculae intact; no nuclear atypia, mitoses or necrosis seen
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive replacement of intertrabecular marrow by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, fibrillary to finely foamy eosinophilic cytoplasm and small bland eccentric nuclei. Residual hematopoiesis and small lymphocytes are displaced to the margins. There is no cytologic atypia, necrosis or granuloma formation. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages, as seen in lysosomal storage disease (e.g., Gaucher disease); correlation with enzyme assay and genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes look similar but occur against a background of CML, myeloma, thalassemia or mycobacterial infection with normal enzyme activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly bubbly vacuolated cytoplasm rather than the fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' texture of Gaucher cells.
MAC-laden histiocytes have striated grey cytoplasm too but are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Signet ring cells are cytokeratin positive with atypical crescent nuclei, while histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive.
